author: New China TV
description: One-fifth the width of an average human hair! That is ultra-fine copper wire produced by a company in Gansu Province, northwest China. #ChinaTech #MadeInChina
title: Made in China: Ultra-fine copper wire thinner than human hair

author: New China TV
description: China's grassroots football tournament Village Super League has come to Fuping, Hebei Province. 27 local teams are battling it out in Fuping division, while visitors enjoy folk performances, traditional crafts, local specialties, and tasty street food. A true countryside football carnival.
title: Grassroots football carnival opens in China's Fuping, boosting local culture & tourism

author: New China TV
description:
"It's really great," said Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic after trying out a Chinese EV at the Xiaomi factory in Beijing.
Vucic is in China for a state visit from May 24 to 28.
title: Serbian president tries out Chinese EV, calls it "really great"

author: New China TV
description: A panda cub at Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding grabbed a rocking horse and started gnawing on it, transforming an ordinary play session into a viral multitasking spectacle. Behind the cuteness is real biology: from around three months old, cubs start growing baby teeth, and by eight months they enter a painful teething phase, driving them to chew anything in reach to soothe their gums and build jaw strength -- yes, even a rocking horse.
title: Rocking horse becomes panda cub's teething tool

author: New China TV
description: During a visit to the Museum of the Communist Party of China (CPC) in Beijing on Tuesday, Serbian President Aleksandar #Vucic left a handwritten message expressing admiration for the development of #China under the #CPC leadership.
title: Serbian president visits CPC museum, hails China's development

author: New China TV
description: China on Tuesday pre-allocated an additional 160 million yuan (about 23 million U.S. dollars) in central natural disaster-relief funds to support five provincial-level regions in southern China, adding to 120 million yuan previously disbursed. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China allocates additional 160 mln yuan for flood, quake relief in southern regions

author: New China TV
description: Nearly a month ago, China cleared its first batch of zero-tariff African goods - 24 tons of South African apples have since entered the Chinese market. The media have taken note of both the policy and how warmly African partners have embraced it.
title: Orchards to Ports: South African apples' zero-tariff voyage to China

author: New China TV
description: Welcome to the 8D wonderland. China's Chongqing after dark is pure magic. Skyscrapers, bridges, and thousands of homes light up in layers, creating a futuristic, vertical light sea. #ChinaTravel #Chongqing #8Dcity #NightView
title: China's Chongqing illuminates night with lightscapes

author: New China TV
description: China's Shenzhou-23 crewed spaceship has lifted off -- and the world is watching. Western media call the mission a key step toward China's crewed moon landing goal, with particular attention on the one-year in-orbit stay experiment this time.
title: Western media hail China's Shenzhou-23 mission as key step in space exploration

author: New China TV
description: "My message to them is just to keep on working very hard, and China will have a bright future," said Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic during his visit to Tsinghua University on Tuesday.
title: Serbian President Vucic visits Tsinghua University

author: New China TV
description: "Having trading partners with China gives us the opportunity for the people of Nauru to have a better opportunity in terms of prosperity and a better standard of living," said Maverick Eoe, Nauru's minister for commerce and foreign investment. #GLOBALink
title: Trade with China helps improve livelihoods in Nauru: Nauruan minister

author: New China TV
description: Music, dance and spontaneous cross-cultural joy lit up the Uzbekistan pavilion at the 10th Silk Road International Exposition in Xi’an. Drawn by the lively performance, a local resident joined an Uzbek exhibitor for an impromptu dance, delighting the crowd with a heartwarming moment of connection and drawing cheers.
title: Spontaneous dance sparks cheers at Silk Road Int'l Expo in Xi'an

author: New China TV
description:
What does it take for a tiny white flower to flourish in the global tea market?
Join Xinhua's Huang Kaiying and two foreign vloggers as they explore jasmine flower picking, tea making and tea culture in China's largest jasmine-producing region. Discover how tradition and technology are helping the sweet fragrance of Hengzhou reach the world. (recorded)
title: From fields to tea cups: How Guangxi's jasmine tea flourishes in global tea market

author: New China TV
description: "Football brings people together and delivers great joy. Bringing in a Chinese player in the future could be one of our targets, and I'm looking forward to it, " said Miroslav Klose, World Cup record scorer and 1. FC Nuremberg's head coach during his visit to China's Shenzhen.
title: Klose praises Sino-German youth football cooperation

author: New China TV
description: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic visited Xiaomi's auto factory in Beijing on Tuesday, getting an up-close look at the Chinese tech giant's intelligent manufacturing and automotive innovations.
title: Serbian president visits tech giant Xiaomi's auto factory

author: New China TV
description: While Muslims worldwide prepare to mark Eid al-Adha by sacrificing animals and sharing meat with families in need, Afghans are once again observing the sacred festival under the heavy shadow of profound economic hardship. #EidAlAdha #Afghanistan
title: Afghans mark Eid al-Adha as tradition collides with crushing poverty

author: New China TV
description: The people of the Miao ethnic group on Monday staged grand celebrations for the traditional Caihuashan Festival. The event, equivalent to their New Year and Valentine's Day, symbolizes family reunion, blessing and romantic courtship. #MiaoCulture #CaihuashanFestival
title: China's Miao ethnic group stages grand celebrations for Caihuashan Festival

author: New China TV
description: China-made 107-meter offshore wind turbine blades are now sailing from Fuzhou to Europe. Produced at GE Vernova's Fujian factory, the giant blades are designed for next-generation 12-16 MW offshore wind turbines. Fujian's growing offshore wind industry is becoming a major export hub for the global renewable energy market.
title: 107-Meter Wind Turbine Blades Made in China Sail from Fuzhou to Europe

author: New China TV
description: From cliffside running to heart-pounding adventures, Hou'er Tiankeng isn't just a scenic spot, but also a real-life Temple Run playground. Join Xinhua as we take the leap. Feel the wind scream past you on a zipline dive and hear the heartbeats on wobbly suspension bridges. (recorded) #Guizhou #ChinaTravel #KarstWonder #OutdoorAdventure #ExtremeSports #TempleRunInRealLife
title: Zipline, wobbly suspension bridge: join Xinhua at Hou'er Tiankeng in SW China's Guizhou

author: New China TV
description: The Lisbon Maru carrying 1,816 British POWs went down in 1942. But 384 survived, plucked from the sea by Chinese fishermen braving Japanese soldiers' machine-gun fire. Decades later, their families came back to Dongji Island to make sure that the story would never be forgotten.
title: British POW descendants return to honor Lisbon Maru rescue

author: New China TV
description:
What is this place?
At first glance, it feels like a museum. A few steps later, robots are playing chess with kids. Around another corner, there are live performances, futuristic tech, handmade crafts, and crowds flowing through giant exhibition halls.
The ongoing China (Shenzhen) International Cultural Industries Fair (ICIF) has brought together more than 120,000 cultural products and over 6,300 exhibitors from across China and beyond. It feels like seeing different sides of China all at once.
title: Inside China's Cultural Fair

author: New China TV
description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda is spreading rapidly, with more than 900 suspected cases and over 200 suspected deaths, the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and the World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Monday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Africa CDC, WHO warn over rapid Ebola spread with over 900 suspected cases
